statement.en: Make a cohesive checkout experience available when applicable.

statement.en: Ensure the experience accommodates coupons and promotional codes in the payment sheet.
statement.ja: coupons and promotional codes in the payment sheetを利用できる設計にする。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Restore if-you-offer rather than obliging every merchant to create promotions; remove unsupported Ensure wording from a SHOULD rule.

statement.en: Favor checkout information from Apple Pay when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではcheckout information from Apple Payを優先する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: State the preference directly and preserve the optional fetch even when information already exists.

statement.en: Exclude requiring account creation before purchase from the applicable experience.
statement.ja: 該当する体験ではrequiring account creation before purchaseを避ける。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Avoid requiring account creation before a purchase.
statement.ja: 購入前にアカウント作成を必須にしない。

conditions: If registration is desired, ask on the order confirmation page and prepopulate as many fields as possible with checkout information.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Repair the negative template and prioritize the person’s purchase intent without forced registration.

statement.en: Present an order confirmation or thank-you page in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況でan order confirmation or thank-you pageを表示する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

conditions: Provide shipping timing and how to check order status.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Restore the sequence and optional payment-method reference instead of a generic documented-context wrapper.

statement.en: Present the active coupon or promotional code, or let people enter one in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況でthe active coupon or promotional code, or let people enter oneを表示する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Repair the template and retain both alternatives and the optional additional entry route.

statement.en: Preserve people’s ability to choose the shipping method in the payment sheet.
statement.ja: 利用者がchoose the shipping method in the payment sheetできる状態を保つ。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Preserve shipping choice, space constraints, and optional estimates without changing their strength.

statement.en: Choose or apply line items to explain additional charges, discounts, pending costs, add-on donations, recurring payments, and future payments in the documented context.

statement.en: Maintain line items short.
statement.ja: line items shortを維持する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

conditions: Use specific wording and fit each item on one line whenever possible.

conditions: Use the business name people will find for the charge on their bank or credit-card statement.

statement.en: Apply the documented Apple Pay guidance to defer to the payment sheet for progress information during payment.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the apply-guidance template with the actual state-feedback recommendation.

conditions: In a side-by-side layout, place Apple Pay to the right of Add to Cart.

previous.title: Maintain the minimum button size and margins around the button

conditions: Plain Apple Pay: minimum width 100 pt (100 px @1x; 200 px @2x).
Book, Buy, Check Out, Donate, Set Up, and Subscribe types: minimum width 140 pt (140/280 px @1x/@2x).

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Button size and position rows205/208/210; live table rowspan6 verified the six 140pt types. Preserve SHOULD; do not generalize to unlisted types.

previous.title: Cancel interrupted Apple Pay payments

statement.en: Cancel any in-progress Apple Pay payment when its payment flow is interrupted.
statement.ja: Apple Pay payment flowが中断された場合は進行中のpaymentをキャンセルする。

conditions: Apply when an interruption ends or invalidates the in-progress payment flow.

current.title: Cancel Apple Pay payments when interruption dismisses the sheet

statement.en: Cancel any in-progress Apple Pay payment when an interruption dismisses its payment sheet.
statement.ja: 中断によってApple Payの支払いシートが閉じた場合、進行中の支払いをキャンセルする。

conditions: Examples include cancellation or timeout during the payment flow.
After dismissal, people can restart by choosing the Apple Pay button again.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Payment processing problems row106: explicit must applies to interruptions such as cancellation/timeout dismissing the sheet; preserve MUST.

previous.title: Ensure subscription terms are understood before authorization
conditions: Apply to recurring payments and subscription purchases before authorization.

current.title: Clarify subscription terms before the Apple Pay sheet
conditions: Before showing the payment sheet, clarify recurring-payment frequency and other terms of service.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Supporting subscriptions row118: make sure supports existing MUST; align condition/title with statement's before-sheet boundary.

previous.title: Show the current subscription amount at authorization
conditions: Apply when a subscription includes discounts, later price changes, or additional upfront fees.

current.title: Show the subscription amount charged at authorization
conditions: Use the total line to clarify the amount billed at authorization for a subscription payment.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Supporting subscriptions row130: make sure supports MUST for subscription authorizations generally, not only discounts/price changes/upfront-fee cases.

statement.en: Ensure the Apple Pay mark is at least as tall as other payment-brand marks displayed with it.
statement.ja: Apple Pay markを併記する他のpayment-brand mark以上の高さにする。

conditions: Apply when the Apple Pay mark appears with other payment-brand marks.

statement.en: Ensure the Apple Pay mark is no shorter than other payment-brand marks in the payment flow.
statement.ja: Apple Payマークの高さを、その支払いフロー内の他の決済ブランドのマーク以上にする。

conditions: Compare with other payment-brand marks used in the payment flow, not only marks simultaneously displayed beside Apple Pay.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Apple Pay mark row230: make sure supports MUST; payment-flow comparison is broader than existing displayed-with-it restriction.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Referring to Apple Pay row250: Always supports existing English-only MUST even in localized text; Apple trademark wording guidance only.

conditions: Apply in payment-selection contexts where another option includes an icon or logo.
exceptions: A text-only Apple Pay description is permitted only when every payment option is text-only.

conditions: Applies when any other payment option uses an icon or logo in a payment-selection context.
Text-only Apple Pay is an available alternative only when every payment option is text-only.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Referring to Apple Pay row252: explicit must supports current level; all-text alternative is outside the trigger, not an exception allowing omission with icons.
